name: smwsprites-mechakoopa-but-awesome-v1
title: Mechakoopa but Awesome v1.0
description:
This is based on the Mario Maker 2 take on the Mechakoopa. It comes in four variants:
- Green: the defualt one you're used to
- Red: shoots projectiles
- Blue: shoots lightning
- Yellow: explodes after being damaged
You choose color with the first extra byte. You can set the extra bit to enable the sprite to fly through the air using its jets.

Requested for the Strongest Sprite Workshop 2020 by Anorakun & Blizzard Buffalo
